recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **Chicken**: 1 whole chicken, cooked and shredded ([**0:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=34s)) *(Note: You can substitute a pre-cooked rotisserie chicken) (*[***0:34***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=34s)*).*
- **Onion**: 1 whole onion, diced ([**0:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=40s)).
- **Green Onion**: 4 stalks, chopped ([**6:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=363s)).
- **Pickles**: Approximately 60 g, finely chopped ([**2:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=121s)).
- **Mayonnaise**: 400 g ([**6:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=363s)).
- **Pickle Juice**: Added to taste (to adjust texture and tanginess) ([**7:37**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=457s)).
- **Pickled Jalapeños**: Briefly chopped, added to taste ([**0:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=22s)).
recipe-section-1.html:
• Chicken: 1 whole chicken, cooked and shredded (0:34) (Note: You can substitute a pre-cooked rotisserie chicken) (0:34).
  • Onion: 1 whole onion, diced (0:40).
  • Green Onion: 4 stalks, chopped (6:03).
  • Pickles: Approximately 60 g, finely chopped (2:01).
  • Mayonnaise: 400 g (6:03).
  • Pickle Juice: Added to taste (to adjust texture and tanginess) (7:37).
  • Pickled Jalapeños: Briefly chopped, added to taste (0:22).
recipe-section-1.title: Base Elements

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **Onion Powder**: 5 mL ([**1:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=66s)).
- **Dried Dill**: 5 mL ([**1:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=91s)).
- **Garlic Powder**: 7.5 mL ([**1:51**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=111s)).
- **Italian Seasoning**: 5 mL ([**2:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=125s)).
- **Dried Oregano**: 10 mL ([**2:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=150s)).
- **Salt**: 5 mL (or to taste) ([**2:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=175s)).
- **Black Pepper**: 7.5 mL ([**2:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=175s)).
- **Chilli Flakes**: To taste ([**3:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=204s)).
- **White Pepper**: 15 mL ([**7:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=468s)).
- **Everything Bagel Seasoning**: 59 mL (contains white and dark sesame seeds and fried onion flakes) ([**4:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=241s)).
recipe-section-2.html:
• Onion Powder: 5 mL (1:06).
  • Dried Dill: 5 mL (1:31).
  • Garlic Powder: 7.5 mL (1:51).
  • Italian Seasoning: 5 mL (2:05).
  • Dried Oregano: 10 mL (2:30).
  • Salt: 5 mL (or to taste) (2:55).
  • Black Pepper: 7.5 mL (2:55).
  • Chilli Flakes: To taste (3:24).
  • White Pepper: 15 mL (7:48).
  • Everything Bagel Seasoning: 59 mL (contains white and dark sesame seeds and fried onion flakes) (4:01).
recipe-section-2.title: Seasonings & Spices

recipe-section-4.markdown:
- **Shred the chicken**: If using a fresh whole chicken, cook it fully and shred all the meat into a large mixing bowl ([**0:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=34s)).
- **Chop the aromatics**: Finely dice one whole yellow or white onion ([**0:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=40s)). Chop 4 stalks of green onion ([**6:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=363s)).
- **Chop the pickles**: Finely dice roughly 60 g of your favorite pickles ([**2:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=121s)).
recipe-section-4.html:
• Shred the chicken: If using a fresh whole chicken, cook it fully and shred all the meat into a large mixing bowl (0:34).
  • Chop the aromatics: Finely dice one whole yellow or white onion (0:40). Chop 4 stalks of green onion (6:03).
  • Chop the pickles: Finely dice roughly 60 g of your favorite pickles (2:01).
recipe-section-4.title: Step 1: Prep the Base Ingredients

recipe-section-5.markdown:
- **Add dry spices**: Toss the shredded chicken with 5 mL of onion powder ([**1:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=66s)), 5 mL of dried dill ([**1:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=91s)), 7.5 mL of garlic powder ([**1:51**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=111s)), 5 mL of Italian seasoning ([**2:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=125s)), and 10 mL of oregano ([**2:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=150s)).
- **Add heat and salt**: Mix in 5 mL of salt ([**2:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=175s)), 7.5 mL of black pepper ([**3:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=204s)), a pinch of chilli flakes ([**3:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=204s)), and 15 mL of white pepper ([**8:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=486s)).
- **Incorporate bagel seasoning**: Pour in 59 mL of everything bagel seasoning to introduce a distinct toasted, savory crunch ([**4:37**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=277s)).
recipe-section-5.html:
• Add dry spices: Toss the shredded chicken with 5 mL of onion powder (1:06), 5 mL of dried dill (1:31), 7.5 mL of garlic powder (1:51), 5 mL of Italian seasoning (2:05), and 10 mL of oregano (2:30).
  • Add heat and salt: Mix in 5 mL of salt (2:55), 7.5 mL of black pepper (3:24), a pinch of chilli flakes (3:24), and 15 mL of white pepper (8:06).
  • Incorporate bagel seasoning: Pour in 59 mL of everything bagel seasoning to introduce a distinct toasted, savory crunch (4:37).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 2: Season the Chicken Mix

recipe-section-6.markdown:
1. **Add mayo and veggies**: Toss your diced onion, green onions, and pickles into the seasoned chicken bowl ([**4:53**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=293s)). Add 400 g of mayonnaise ([**6:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=363s)).
2. **Incorporate jalapeños**: Add a small handful of chopped pickled jalapeños into the bowl to balance the richness with heat ([**5:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=301s)).
3. **Stir and thin**: Mix everything together thoroughly ([**5:39**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=339s)). Splash in pickle juice as you stir until the mixture yields a smooth, loose, and dynamic texture ([**8:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=498s)).
recipe-section-6.html:
1. Add mayo and veggies: Toss your diced onion, green onions, and pickles into the seasoned chicken bowl (4:53). Add 400 g of mayonnaise (6:03).
  2. Incorporate jalapeños: Add a small handful of chopped pickled jalapeños into the bowl to balance the richness with heat (5:01).
  3. Stir and thin: Mix everything together thoroughly (5:39). Splash in pickle juice as you stir until the mixture yields a smooth, loose, and dynamic texture (8:18).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 3: Combine with Sauce and Mix
recipe-section-6.heading_html: Step 3: Combine with Sauce and Mix

recipe-section-7.markdown:
- **Adjust to taste**: Take a small spoonful to taste test the salad ([**7:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=434s)). If needed, shake in an extra pinch of salt, pepper, or more jalapeño juice until the flavors pop ([**7:37**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=457s)).
- **Serve**: Aaron recommends enjoying this spicy chicken salad over fresh, sweet brioche bread layered with a side of homemade fruit jam or apple butter ([**5:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pXLW4Fpksg&t=313s)).
recipe-section-7.html:
• Adjust to taste: Take a small spoonful to taste test the salad (7:14). If needed, shake in an extra pinch of salt, pepper, or more jalapeño juice until the flavors pop (7:37).
  • Serve: Aaron recommends enjoying this spicy chicken salad over fresh, sweet brioche bread layered with a side of homemade fruit jam or apple butter (5:13).
recipe-section-7.title: Step 4: Taste Check and Serve
